_comment: TODO: placeholder copy — coherent but not final. Final wording pending review. Keys are top-two axis ids joined alphabetically with '+', plus 'balanced'. Fields are affinity framing (fields that fit how you think), never career advice.

memory+numerical.line: a word for someone who keeps the running total in their head and never loses the thread.
memory+numerical.style: you hold a lot of moving parts at once and keep the numbers straight while you do.

memory+reasoning.line: a word for someone who can juggle the whole board and still see the next move.
memory+reasoning.style: you keep many threads in mind and reason across all of them at once.

memory+spatial.line: a word for someone who builds the whole map in their head and walks it from memory.
memory+spatial.style: you picture how things fit and keep the whole layout in mind while you work.

memory+speed.line: a word for someone who takes it in fast and doesn't let it slip.
memory+speed.style: you absorb things quickly and hold onto them under pressure.

memory+verbal.line: a word for someone who keeps every thread and can always find the words for it.
memory+verbal.style: you remember what was said, and you can put it back into words when it matters.

numerical+reasoning.line: a word for someone who reads the shape of a problem in its numbers.
numerical+reasoning.style: you reason through problems with quantity and proportion doing the heavy lifting.

numerical+spatial.line: a word for someone who sees how it fits together and how much it takes.
numerical+spatial.style: you think in shapes and magnitudes, and you can turn one into the other.

numerical+speed.line: a word for someone who runs the numbers before anyone else has found a pen.
numerical+speed.style: you estimate and calculate quickly, and you trust the quick read.

numerical+verbal.line: a word for someone who can turn a number into a sentence people actually understand.
numerical+verbal.style: you hold the quantitative side and the words for it in the same hand.

reasoning+spatial.line: a word for someone who sees the structure before the noise.
reasoning+spatial.style: you find the underlying pattern and can picture how the pieces move.

reasoning+speed.line: a word for someone who gets to the answer while the question is still in the air.
reasoning+speed.style: you reason fast and back yourself to be right the first time.

reasoning+verbal.line: a word for someone who can think it through and say it clean.
reasoning+verbal.style: you reason your way to the point and put it into clear words.

spatial+speed.line: a word for someone who reads the space and reacts before it closes.
spatial+speed.style: you take in the whole scene fast and move on what you see.

spatial+verbal.line: a word for someone who can see the picture and put it into words.
spatial+verbal.style: you picture things clearly and describe them so others can see them too.

speed+verbal.line: a word for someone who finds the right words before the moment passes.
speed+verbal.style: you think and speak quickly, and the words keep up with you.

balanced.line: a word for someone with no weak side to hide — even strength across the board.
balanced.style: you don't lean on one strength; you bring a bit of everything.
